script_text: What if the universe has been quietly rewiring your entire foundation, Aquarius, and you haven't even felt it yet? This month, revolutionary Uranus, your modern ruler, stations retrograde in your foundational fourth House of home and emotional security, forcing you to confront hidden family dynamics or ancestral patterns that no longer serve your authentic self. Love takes a surprising turn as magnetic Venus in Cancer opposes your seventh House of partnership—someone unexpected may challenge everything you thought you knew about commitment, forcing you to choose between independence and intimacy. Professionally, disciplined Saturn trines your tenth House of career while Jupiter squares your second House of income, signaling a major restructuring of your public image that could bring long-term recognition but requires patience with financial delays now. Mars in bold Aries energizes your sixth House of daily routine, giving you the stamina to overhaul your health habits, though restlessness may push you to overdo it. Mark August 15th when Uranus goes retrograde—hidden truths emerge; August 23rd as the Sun enters Virgo, clarifying your daily goals; and August 28th when Pluto completes its transit through your eighth House, revealing secrets about shared resources. Beware of resisting necessary changes at home—they will resurface with greater force later. Stop waiting for permission and start building the life your authentic Aquarius self demands—comment your sign.
